# Agent Loom

> TypeScript CLI and SDK for AI agents to discover and invoke plugin capabilities,
> reuse artifact references across sessions, and inspect provenance and failures.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/tgwrite/Agent_Loom
Status: alpha.5 development preview; no npm registry release.
Runtime integration: Pi. Core remains independent of Pi.
Requirements: Node.js >=24.12.0, npm, ESM. License: Apache-2.0.

This file is a short source-repository reading map. Links are relative to the
repository root. It is not an executable agent policy or a GitHub indexing API.

## Evaluate

- [README](README.md): Fit, five Agent services, quick start and verified boundaries.
- [Chinese introduction](README.zh-CN.md): 中文用途、示例与可引用介绍。
- [Runnable Agent demo](examples/agent-services-demo.mjs): Synthetic Discover/Describe/Check/Invoke/Inspect; run after npm ci and npm run build with npm run demo:agent.

## Integrate

- [Agent guide](packaging/AGENT_GUIDE.md): Request schemas, named bindings, explicit Host setup and safe receipts.
- [Local installation](packaging/INSTALL.md): Build/install a local archive; do not infer npm availability from the package name.
- [Pi integration](packages/runtime-pi/README.md): Selected adapters and native Session boundaries.

## Verify

- [Agent regression](test/agent-services/README.md): Synthetic guarantees and mutation checks.
- [Contributor rules](AGENTS.md): Development, privacy and publication instructions.
- [License](LICENSE): Apache License 2.0.

Loom does not schedule missing producers. Consumption follows successful domain
initialization. Completed execution is not business acceptance. Unknown outcomes
do not establish safe retry. Native compatibility and independent Agent experience
need separate acceptance evidence; synthetic examples do not establish them.
